documentation.file_docstring: Governance Server Local development server for browser-based governance dashboard viewing. Uses Node's built-in http module and ws package for WebSocket support. Broadcasts SLO, topology, and audit updates to all connected clients.
inline_comments: Local development server for governance dashboard visualization. Serves an HTML dashboard accessible via browser and pushes real-time updates to connected WebSocket clients. Uses singleton pattern to ensure only one server instance runs at a time.
Start the server on the specified or default port. Automatically finds an available port if the default is occupied.
SECURITY: Session token via Sec-WebSocket-Protocol subprotocol header.
Avoids query string logging by proxies/debug tools. Server binds to 127.0.0.1 only.
